notes.title: Suicide Guy VR Deluxe available today for PlayStation VR2!
notes.content:
Hello my friends!
The latest VR edition of Suicide Guy is today available for PlayStation VR2!

Check it out!

https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10008626


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29702066/a1be279db82ef737556b4922c9074402d6bfbf84.jpg[/img]


A first person puzzle game like no other where you'll have to find the way out of your own dreams using objects and tools that you'll obtain during the nap.

Play this super immersive experience with your PSVR2 Device.


[b]Features:[/b]

- New awesome levels that take full advantage of VR devices

- Full body locomotion in Virtual Reality

- Total physics control of all items

- New incredible moves: be able to pick up items, throw them, activate mechanisms and even burp.

- Driving System redesigned for VR

- Teleport movement style extra option (if your stomach can't take it)

- An important mission to accomplish (again)


[b]What Does the new Deluxe edition includes?[/b]

- Graphics and performance improvements

- Fully adapted for PlayStation VR2 devices

- Improved comfort for VR

notes.title: News from the upcoming DLC!
notes.content:
[img]https://imgur.com/9rxshrb.jpg[/img]


[h1]Hello my friends!
The new DLC for [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/303610/Suicide_Guy/]Suicide Guy[/url] is going to be released soon:
we've decided to take some more weeks of development in order to expand the content and polish the original game ːsuicideguyː

[b]Thanks to your constant support we were able to continue the development of the DLC even further. [/b]

In the first months after the release, the game has already sold over 20.000 copies on Steam only and thanks to that we were able to bring the game on [url=https://store.playstation.com/en-us/product/UP2796-CUSA11124_00-0000000000000000]PlayStation 4 [/url]  and (soon) Switch! 

Suicide Guy: Sleepin' Deeply will feature the following:
[b]
- A whole new Story
- 6 New crazy original levels
- New achievements and collectables
[/b]

Here some in game screens:

[img]https://imgur.com/Px1C1xZ.jpg[/img]

[img]https://imgur.com/Zk0Kaai.jpg[/img]

Stay tuned for further updates.
We're also working on a new game and I hope we'll be able to announce it soon!
MalboM

[/h1]
